Alex M: Morning — quick async check-in. What I did yesterday: shipped the optical-batching change to staging, ran long-seq perf suite. Blockers: saw a ~12% tail latency regression on 4k+ token requests when KV cache hit-rate is low. Today: rolling a canary, adding extra tracing, and will coordinate rollback if canary looks bad. :eyes:
Priya R: Nice work. Does the regression surface for user-facing routes or just internal load tests?
Alex M: Mostly internal for now — reproduced on staging with the customer-sim workload. No user-facing incidents yet. Canary will target a subset of traffic to lowest-risk routes.
Jordan K: I can take tracing on this. Can you paste the reproducer command?
Alex M: Sure — run this on the staging load generator: `./run_load.sh --profile customer-sim --seq-len 4096 --concurrency 12 --kv-hit 0.2`
Jordan K: Got it. I'll attach flamegraphs and post here when ready.
Sam T: Quick ask: @Priya R can you review my PR for the rollout policy change? It's the small change to fallback order (dedicated -> hosted -> private). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/routing/234
Priya R: On it. ETA end of day. If it intersects with the canary traffic rules, ping me immediately.
Casey L: Ops note: gpu-2 saw memory spikes during the long-seq test yesterday — watching more closely this morning. If it recurs, I'll quarantine that node. :warning:
Alex M: Thanks Casey. If you see >85% GPU memory sustained, hold canary traffic and notify the channel.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by alexm — canary group: 5% traffic -> staging profile -> optical-batching:v2.
Jordan K: First flamegraphs uploaded to the trace bucket: s3://redwood-traces/staging/1956012345/ — looking into kernel stalls.
Sam T: Heads-up for the team: I'm pairing with @Priya R on the rollout policy review at 3pm PT, feel free to drop questions before then.
Alex M: Plan B if canary shows regression: immediate rollback to optical-batching:v1, open follow-up ticket to debug scheduler heuristics. Will post canary results here in ~2 hours. :rocket:
Priya R: Thanks — will prioritize the PR review if canary is green.
Casey L: I'll post GPU utilization snapshots every 30m in this thread until end of day.
Alex M: Appreciated. Short-term ask: if anyone has spare cycles, please scan the canary logs for `kv_cache_miss_ratio` spikes and drop flags here.
Priya R: Copy that.
Jordan K: On it.
Sam T: Thanks all — keep updates coming. :thumbsup:
